        (Plants_10_B == 1) + b_NativeDecrease * (Native_Decrease_B == 
        1) + b_NativeIncrease * (Native_Increase_B == 1) + b_Appearance_W * 
        (Appearance_W_B == 1) + b_Appearance_WYB * (Appearance_WYB_B == 
        1) + b_Appearance_WYBPR * (Appearance_WYBPR_B == 1) + 
        b_PollinatorQualityMedium * (PollinatorQuality_Medium_B == 
            1) + b_PollinatorQualityHigh * (PollinatorQuality_High_B == 
        1) + (b_type * Treated * 1) + (b_type_Plants_5 * Plants_5_B * 
        Treated) + (b_type_Plants_10 * Plants_10_B * Treated) + 
        (b_type_Native_Decrease * Native_Decrease_B * Treated) + 
        (b_type_Native_Increase * Native_Increase_B * Treated) + 
        (b_type_Appearance_W * Appearance_W_B * Treated) + (b_type_Appearance_WYB * 
        Appearance_WYB_B * Treated) + (b_type_Appearance_WYBPR * 
        Appearance_WYBPR_B * Treated) + (b_type_PollinatorQuality_Medium * 
        PollinatorQuality_Medium_B * Treated) + (b_type_PollinatorQuality_High * 
        PollinatorQuality_High_B * Treated) - costB)
    V[["C"]] = -b_Cost * (b_Plants5 * (Plants_5_C == 1) + b_Plants10 * 
        (Plants_10_C == 1) + b_NativeDecrease * (Native_Decrease_C == 
        1) + b_NativeIncrease * (Native_Increase_C == 1) + b_Appearance_W * 
        (Appearance_W_C == 1) + b_Appearance_WYB * (Appearance_WYB_C == 
        1) + b_Appearance_WYBPR * (Appearance_WYBPR_C == 1) + 
        b_PollinatorQualityMedium * (PollinatorQuality_Medium_C == 
            1) + b_PollinatorQualityHigh * (PollinatorQuality_High_C == 
        1) + (b_type * Treated * 1) + (b_type_Plants_5 * Plants_5_C * 
        Treated) + (b_type_Plants_10 * Plants_10_C * Treated) + 
        (b_type_Native_Decrease * Native_Decrease_C * Treated) + 
        (b_type_Native_Increase * Native_Increase_C * Treated) + 
        (b_type_Appearance_W * Appearance_W_C * Treated) + (b_type_Appearance_WYB * 
        Appearance_WYB_C * Treated) + (b_type_Appearance_WYBPR * 
        Appearance_WYBPR_C * Treated) + (b_type_PollinatorQuality_Medium * 
        PollinatorQuality_Medium_C * Treated) + (b_type_PollinatorQuality_High * 
        PollinatorQuality_High_C * Treated) - costC)
    V[["D"]] = asc_D + beta_IncomeDummy * IncomeDummy + beta_AgeDummy * 
        AgeDummy + beta_Gender * Gender + beta_freqv * FrequencyOfVisit + 
        beta_CNS_ScaleMean * CNS_ScaleMean_MeanUpdated + beta_visittime * 
        visittime + b_EC_Park_Burley * EC_Park_Burley + b_EC_Park_Gores_Marsh * 
        EC_Park_Gores_Marsh + b_EC_Park_Horfield_Common * EC_Park_Horfield_Common + 
        b_EC_Park_Inch_Park * EC_Park_Inch_Park + b_EC_Park_King_Lane * 
        EC_Park_King_Lane + b_EC_Park_Middleton * EC_Park_Middleton + 
        b_EC_Park_Pilrig * EC_Park_Pilrig + b_EC_Park_Rodley * 
        EC_Park_Rodley + b_EC_Park_St_Andrews * EC_Park_St_Andrews + 
        b_EC_Park_St_Marks * EC_Park_St_Marks
    mnl_settings = list(alternatives = c(A = 1, B = 2, C = 3, 
        D = 4), avail = list(A = 1, B = 1, C = 1, D = 1), choiceVar = choice, 
        utilities = V)
    P[["model"]] = apollo_mnl(mnl_settings, functionality)
    P = apollo_panelProd(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
    P = apollo_avgInterDraws(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
    P = apollo_weighting(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
    P = apollo_prepareProb(P, apollo_inputs, functionality)
    return(P)
}
